welcome:
👋 Welcome to **Albert Quiz Bot**!

I automatically post non-repeating, randomized quizzes to Telegram groups and channels.

📌 **Features:**
• Continuous 24/7 automated quizzes
• 50,000+ questions across 13+ categories
• Automatic leaderboard tracking (+5 points correct, +2 fastest bonus)

Add me to your group or channel as an Administrator to get started automatically!
help:
📖 **Albert Quiz Bot Commands:**

/start - Welcome message
/help - Show this help menu
/stats - Show quiz bot statistics
/categories - Browse available quiz categories
/leaderboard - View group & global leaderboards
/myscore - Check your personal scores & rank
/random - Request an instant quiz question
admin_only: ⚠️ This command is restricted to Bot Administrators.
group_admin_only: ⚠️ This command is restricted to Group Administrators.
quiz_started: 🎯 **New Quiz Question!** Answer below. Active for 10 minutes.
